name: candidate-job-matching-cdc
notes: SOURCE connector. Debezium PostgreSQL via pgoutput (logical decoding, wal_level=logical).
Keyed by ENTITY ID: Connect key is the table PK struct -> {candidate_id|post_id|application_id}.
Payload shape op/before/after is preserved; deletes carry the full before image (REPLICA IDENTITY FULL).
tombstones.on.delete=false is DELIBERATE and matches the tuned match_engine/bronze path:
null-value records would violate the explicit JSON schemas Spark expects. Remove this flag only
with a matching migration of every JSON consumer (documented trade-off in README/topics docs).
HONEST LIMITATION: source connectors do NOT support errors.deadletterqueue.* - the DLQ mechanism
only exists for SINK connectors. For the source we get bounded retries + error logging + skip:
